title: JavaScript Mastery Workbook
subtitle: Zero to Interview-Ready: Step-by-step roadmap, practice labs, guided projects, MCQs & 593 interview Q&As
howToUse: Roadmap Flow → Follow Part A in order: key concepts, live example, and 6 progressive tasks per topic
Practice Loop → Solve first in the Right IDE; reveal Step 1 → Step 2 → Step 3 hints only if stuck (never copy-paste)
Guided Projects → Start Part B after Topics 4–14; build milestone by milestone using Live Web Preview
Interview Recall → Review 15–20 Part C questions daily before checking answers; write C2 code from scratch
Self-Assessment → Test yourself with all 150 Part D MCQs in the Course MCQs tab and review explanations
Runtime Verification → Every snippet and output challenge is tested and verified on Node.js 22 & Browser DOM
researchNotes: Curriculum Alignment → Benchmarked against javascript.info, freeCodeCamp, The Odin Project, and core JS/DSA tracks
Learning Sequence → Foundations → Functions → Arrays & Objects → ES6+ → DOM & Events → Async & Fetch → Error Handling → Node Tooling → Projects → Interview Prep
Interview Coverage → Focuses on high-frequency JavaScript & DSA coding patterns asked in product and service interviews

checklist: Explain closures, this binding, hoisting & the event loop confidently without notes
Write resilient Promise.all / async-await / fetch code with proper error handling
Solve at least 10 array transformations cleanly using map, filter & reduce
Deploy 3 complete projects to GitHub with clear READMEs and live screenshots
Implement debounce, throttle, memoize, curry & deep clone from scratch
Analyze Big-O complexity and solve 40+ array, string & hash-map problems
Use Git, npm scripts & browser DevTools breakpoints/Network inspector fluently
